summary: Requesty's Free tier gives access to listed models at $0 through the same OpenAI-compatible gateway (NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra/Super/Nano, Poolside Laguna, Google Gemma 4, Mistral Leanstral, and a Nemotron content-safety model). New organizations get 200 requests per day and 20 RPM across all free models combined; paying organizations get 1,000/day and 60 RPM. No credit card. Docs say these models are free for now and any pricing change will be announced in the changelog.
claim_steps: Create a Requesty account at requesty.ai/pricing (no credit card required).
Create an API key and call router.requesty.ai/v1 with a listed free model id (for example nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b).
Stay within the org-wide free-model limits: 200 requests/day and 20 RPM until the org is paying.

social_proof.title: Pricing: Free Tier & Pay-As-You-Go LLM Gateway | Requesty
social_proof.text: The full platform, on free models. Access to all free models. 200 requests per day. No credit card required. Start free with 200 requests a day, or pay as you go for 5% on model cost.
